svg.title: Hotel receptionist — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as hotel receptionist, wearing a tailored jacket. Visible work cue: A compact reception desk bell stands beside an upright key card with a separated slot mark. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: a shaved head, a rounded face.
